finalText:
Both the runner (625/625 passing) and `verify.js` confirm it's fixed.

The bug: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js` applied tax to the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, despite its own comment saying tax should be charged on what the customer actually pays. Only order rows with *both* a nonzero discount and tax rate exposed it, which is why most of the earlier passing cases masked it. Fixed by taxing the discounted total instead of the original.
